verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no user-definable rule engine or event-triggered automation in Paychex Flex. The API overview lists Webhooks only as a topic heading, which is a developer building block, not user-configured rules. Built-in automatic tax filing, compliance alerts and Intelligent Pay Cycle flags are vendor-defined adjacent features, not rules a user defines to trigger actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
